title: Carport for 2 cars + office and bike room (9.95 x 6.0 m)
description: Option 3 for House > Garage (Proposed), the 'design for the final state' idea. One mono-pitch roof over two car bays at the house end and an insulated 3.2 x 3.9 m box at the east end: a bike and storage room toward the road and an office of about 2.9 x 2.3 m with a window to the garden. The box has a timber floor on ground screws, so there is no slab. The roofed area is 59.2 m2 (59.7 m2 over the roof sheet edge): just under the 60 m2 line, so it needs a building notice and design project, not a permit (the detailed plan still applies). The box's east wall is about 2-3 m from the boundary with 0127, so it must be EI60 (fire-rated board) with no window, plus a written agreement with the neighbour. The roof takes about 24 panels (about 10 kWp).
anchored: Stands on ground screws, so there is no tip check.

parts.role: AXPK 4x25 service cables leave distribution point 1239 heading south then east, about 2 m from the pad's NE corner. Positions on utility maps can be off by a metre; order an on-site marking.
